name: Track Spending : Wise Budget
description:
Spending & Income : Wise Budget

Manage and Control Your Daily Revenue with Ease

Control your finances count your money and monitor your daily revenue with Wise Budget: Spending & Income. This ultimate app provides powerful features to help you manage your finances, stay within your budget, and make informed financial decisions.

Track Your Expenses and Manage Your Budget
With Wise Budget, you can track your expenses and manage your budget, allowing you to see where your money is going and adjust your spending habits as needed.

Customize Categories for Better Management
Customize your budget categories by adding new ones that match your lifestyle, such as gym expenses, food costs, and more, to better manage your finances.

Monitor Your Income and Expenses in Real-time
Monitor your income, expenses, and budget in real-time with Wise Budget, making informed financial decisions and keeping track of your progress towards your financial goals.

Analyze Your Spending Habits with Budget Analysis
Understand your spending habits with Wise Budget's budget analysis feature, which helps you identify areas where you may be overspending and make adjustments to your budget as needed.

Track Your Expenses with Spending Tracker and Money Counter
With Wise Budget's spending tracker, keep a close eye on your expenses, making informed decisions about your spending habits.

Protect Your Financial Information with Biometric Authentication
Protect your financial information with Wise Budget's biometric authentication feature, ensuring only you can access your financial information, so you can have peace of mind knowing that your data is safe and secure.

Backup Your Data to Google Drive for Safekeeping
Never lose your financial data with Wise Budget's auto backup to Google Drive feature, automatically backing up your data to Google Drive, so you can easily restore it in the event of data loss or device damage.

Create Multiple Accounts with Different Currencies
With Wise Budget, create multiple accounts and use different currencies for each one, perfect for managing finances across multiple currencies or multiple sources of income.

Upgrade to Premium and Enjoy an Ad-free Experience
Upgrade to Wise Budget's premium version and enjoy an ad-free experience, with access to additional features like custom budget periods and detailed expense reports.

Print Debts, Expenses, and Income as PDF and Excel Files
Easily print your debts, expenses, and income as PDF and Excel files with Wise Budget's printing feature, perfect for keeping a physical record of your financial transactions.

Visualize Your Data with Charts and Graphs
See your financial data come to life with Wise Budget's charts and graphs feature, making it easy to understand your spending habits and identify areas for improvement.

Save Money and Achieve Your Financial Goals
With Wise Budget - Money Counter , save money and achieve your financial goals, whether it's paying off debt, saving for a vacation, or planning for retirement.

Set Up Monthly Budgets with Budget Planner
Take control of your spending with Wise Budget: Spending & Income's monthly budget analysis feature and budget planner, helping you manage your finances and revenue on a daily basis.

Download Wise Budget خەرجیەکانم now and start managing your finances with ease. With our intuitive interface and powerful features, you can take control of your finances today.
